about: Scoped missing evidence. kind is photo, map or measurement. Received evidence requires source inspection before it is answered. These requests do not block unrelated work.

requests.ask: Side-on photo from the lawn path of the northwest tiled stair and curved wall, plus a view from the top looking down, showing the floor joins and stair ends.
requests.why: Resolve the stair/terrace position and height transition without guessing concealed limits.

requests.ask: A dated georeferenced plan or clear aerial with identifiable ground-wall corners and unobscured Isabel-side access edges. Record scale, registration controls, held-out landmarks and uncertainty. If roof/vegetation cover prevents tracing ground edges, request ground photos instead.
requests.why: Existing aerials and elevated photos do not establish every concealed patio boundary or access width. This flags those limits only; visible pool and facade work can continue.
